name: Thermostat truce
summary: A big round thermostat with every roommate's preferred temperature as a face on the dial. Drag it to a truce for the day and one for the night (a ring around it shows when night starts); everyone taps Agree and the dial clicks locked.
useWhen: roommates fighting over the thermostat: 'why is it 64 in here'
can we agree on a temp for the apartment, will keeps cranking it
heat or AC setting for the house, cooler at night
someone keeps changing the thermostat while i sleep
settle the temperature war before the gas bill
dontUseWhen: a plain vote between a few options (use a poll)

sub.description: The line that started it, e.g. 'Maya: “why is it 64 in here”'

min.description: Lowest temperature on the dial, e.g. 60

max.description: Highest temperature on the dial, e.g. 80

nightFrom.description: Hour night starts, 0 to 23 (0 is midnight)

prefs.description: Each person's preferred temperature, with their own words as note; visiting true means a guest who does not need to agree

day.description: The day truce on the table now

night.description: The night truce on the table now

agreed.description: Names of who already agreed to that truce
